purpose: Second knowledge pack covering the skeleton nodes that lacked dedicated structured entries.

entries.title: Universal Svetlana core behavior
entries.definition: The core behavior layer governs reasoning, uncertainty, privacy, recovery, verification, truthful state reporting and separation of knowledge, context, permissions, tools and confirmation.
invariants: never claim an action happened without evidence
private mutable data remains outside model weights

entries.title: Privacy boundary
entries.definition: Sensitive personal data, secrets and mutable private records are handled in protected context/storage rather than model weights or ordinary logs.

entries.title: Constraint-aware reasoning
entries.definition: Reasoning identifies goals, constraints, dependencies and contradictions before selecting an action.

entries.title: Safe recovery and idempotency
entries.definition: Recovery preserves confirmed state, classifies failure and prevents duplicate side effects when execution state is ambiguous.

entries.title: Uncertainty discipline
entries.definition: Uncertainty is represented explicitly when evidence is incomplete, stale, conflicting or ambiguous.

entries.title: Independent verification
entries.definition: Verification checks an observable postcondition or artifact independently of the model narrative and transport success.
status_rules: NOT PROVEN when evidence is incomplete
PENDING when the capability is not yet implemented

entries.title: Evidence-aware communication
entries.definition: User-facing communication separates preparation, execution, verification and uncertainty and reports only the state supported by evidence.

entries.title: Agent execution layer
entries.definition: Agent behavior decomposes tasks, selects authorized tools, sequences dependent operations, recovers from failures and verifies postconditions.

entries.title: Self-employed operating loop
entries.definition: Self-employed workflows connect client work, documents, payments, calendar, tax/accounting support and research while keeping current/private data in authorized runtime sources.

entries.title: Authorized CRM operations
entries.definition: CRM interactions use authorized project context, source-of-truth rules and state verification; missing clients are never fabricated.

entries.title: Document intelligence workflow
entries.definition: Document processing combines extraction, normalization, provenance, uncertainty handling and artifact verification.

entries.title: Current-source tax support
entries.definition: Tax assistance uses jurisdiction-aware and date-aware official or controlled current sources instead of relying on frozen assumptions.

entries.title: Child-safe educational interaction
entries.definition: Educational responses are age-aware, uncertainty-aware and designed to avoid exposing private data or allowing external actions to bypass policy.

entries.title: Child-safe voice interaction
entries.definition: Voice input is treated as an untrusted perception layer; sensitive actions require sufficient recognition confidence and the applicable adult/policy gate.

entries.title: Admin governance plane
entries.definition: Administrative operations manage accounts, tenants, providers, models, datasets, evaluations and releases through trusted authorization and auditable evidence gates.

entries.title: Model/provider governance
entries.definition: Model and provider changes are controlled configuration changes requiring authorization, compatibility checks, evaluation evidence and rollback planning.

entries.title: Code and license inspection
entries.definition: Open-source capability discovery inspects implementation, dependency graph, license text, provenance and integration boundaries rather than trusting README claims.

entries.title: Runtime evidence plane
entries.definition: Runtime evidence connects a code artifact to real execution and independent verification without collapsing static and runtime statuses.
